connector.name: UnCorreoTemporal
connector.registryDescription: Temporary email for AI agents: create inboxes, wait for emails, extract OTPs, verify signups.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package uncorreotemporal-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the francofuji account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UCT_API_KEY
env.description: Your UnCorreoTemporal API key (get one at https://uncorreotemporal.com). Format: uct_...

env.name: UCT_API_BASE
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://uncorreotemporal.com

env.name: UCT_MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode: stdio (default), streamable-http, or sse
